evals.prompt: Use the wordpress-plugins skill to scaffold a plugin called 'Team Digest' into {workdir}, then install its dev dependencies and run its linter and its test suite. Report the exact commands you ran and their exit codes.

assertions.text: tests/bootstrap.php and tests/PluginTest.php exist in the scaffolded plugin
composer.json contains a test script, phpunit/phpunit ^10 in require-dev, and config.allow-plugins for the phpcodesniffer installer
composer test was run and exited 0
composer lint was run and exited 0

evals.prompt: Audit the WordPress plugin at {workdir}/broken-fixture using the wordpress-plugins skill's audit workflow. List every finding with its checklist ID.

assertions.text: the audit reports the test harness as missing or broken (A7 for the candidate; any equivalent finding counts for the baseline)
the harness finding cites at least one concrete detection: unresolvable phpunit bootstrap path, no *Test.php in tests/, or composer test absent/failing

evals.prompt: Using the wordpress-plugins skill, extend the plugin at {workdir}/team-digest: add (a) an admin settings page storing an option 'td_digest_options' that is read only on that settings screen, and (b) a sortable 'Priority' column (backed by post meta 'td_priority') on the 'digest' custom post type.

assertions.text: register_setting is called with a sanitize_callback
the option is initialized via add_option with autoload false, and no 'autoload' key is passed in register_setting args
all three column hooks are registered: manage_digest_posts_columns, manage_digest_posts_custom_column, manage_edit-digest_sortable_columns
meta-backed ordering is implemented in pre_get_posts guarded by is_admin and main-query checks
